title: The Appropriate gift for the teacher
subtitle: 人际沟通 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 人际沟通（人与社会·社会服务与人际沟通·人际沟通与交流）
meta: 主题语境：人际沟通（人与社会·社会服务与人际沟通·人际沟通与交流）　|　核心词汇：appropriate　|　正文 338 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 appropriate 的用法与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1987 the athlete wrote of ① an appropriate gift for the teacher in the programme, and everybody in the stadium said at once that it was ② more appropriate than the one named there the year before. Three years on, people still spoke of that morning, and of how the athlete, who never explained anything, had done it without complaint and gone home; it was the appropriate ones, my mother said, that people remembered longest.

It was ③ the most appropriate gift for the teacher anybody in the stadium had ever seen, or so the programme for September 1981 claims. My mother, who had seen them all, thought it ④ too appropriate to be of any use to anybody, and said as much to the trainer who had come to help; the appropriate ones, she used to say, were never the useful ones.

My uncle, who kept the bib at the far track, meant something else entirely. He called the whole business ⑤ an appropriate moment to speak, and said that no trainer in his right mind would call it ⑥ as appropriate as the moment to speak they had once had in the old stadium. He was never a man who cared whether a thing was appropriate or not, and he said so.

By 1994 the matter had shrunk to half a line in the programme. What the line asked for was ⑦ something appropriate, and nothing besides. The trainer from the next stadium called the whole plan ⑧ quite appropriate; everybody laughed, and then did exactly what he had said. After that the programme kept the names of the appropriate ones only.

My mother said nothing at all. In 1997, with great care, she wrote of another appropriate gift for the teacher in the same programme, and the work, which took two years, seemed  more appropriate than anybody had expected.  The most appropriate moment to speak in the whole stadium, she said in 1999, was the one she could never quite name; the appropriate ones, she added, are always the ones that stay.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. adj. 合适（前置定语 an appropriate gift for the teacher：1987 年运动员在秩序册里记下的那件合适的礼物）
B. adj. 合适／恰当（比较级 more appropriate than：文中两处，一处比给老师的礼物，一处比预想）
C. adj. 合适／恰当（最高级 the most appropriate：文中两处，见第 3、10 题）
D. adj. 合适（表语 too appropriate to do：母亲觉得它太合适，反倒派不上用场）
E. adj. 恰当（前置定语 an appropriate moment to speak：叔叔把整件事称作一桩恰当的时机）
F. adj. 恰当（同级比较 as appropriate as：拿眼前这桩跟旧日那桩开口的时机相比）
G. adj. 恰当（后置定语 something appropriate：修饰不定代词时须放在其后）
H. adj. 恰当（受程度副词修饰 quite appropriate：那位陪练的评价）

items.q: an appropriate gift for the teacher
the most appropriate gift for the teacher anybody

answers.why: appropriate 意为“合适”，1987 年运动员在秩序册里记下的是“一件合适的礼物”，此处作前置定语 an appropriate gift for the teacher。
appropriate 意为“合适”，此处用比较级 more appropriate than，拿它跟前一年记下的那一个相比。
appropriate 意为“合适”，秩序册上 九月 那行字说它是体育场里最合适的一件，故用最高级 the most appropriate gift for the teacher。
appropriate 意为“合适”，母亲认为这件东西“太合适了，谁也用不上”，too appropriate to do 表示“太……以致不能”。
appropriate 意为“恰当”，叔叔把整件事称作“一桩恰当的时机”，此处作前置定语 an appropriate moment to speak。
appropriate 意为“恰当”，叔叔不肯说它“跟旧日那桩开口的时机一样恰当”，同级比较用 as appropriate as。
appropriate 意为“恰当”，秩序册上那半行字要的是“恰当的东西”，something 被形容词修饰时形容词须后置：something appropriate。
appropriate 意为“恰当”，邻体育场来的那位陪练认为这套计划“相当恰当”，quite 修饰原级 appropriate。

task2.title: Task 2　语境运用
task2.intro: 请把下列句子译成英文，括号里是必须用到的形式。
items: 1987 年，运动员在秩序册里记下了一件合适的礼物。（an appropriate gift for the teacher）
人人都说它比前一年记下的那一个更合适。（more appropriate than …）
母亲觉得它太合适，谁也用不上。（too appropriate to …）
叔叔把整件事称作一桩恰当的时机。（an appropriate moment to speak）
他说，谁也不会认为它跟旧日那桩开口的时机一样恰当。（as appropriate as …）
到了 1994 年，秩序册上只剩半行字：要的是一件恰当的东西。（something appropriate）
answers: In 1987 the athlete wrote of an appropriate gift for the teacher in the programme.
Everybody said it was more appropriate than the one named there the year before.
My mother thought it too appropriate to be of any use to anybody.
My uncle called the whole business an appropriate moment to speak.
He said nobody would call it as appropriate as the moment to speak they had once had.
By 1994 the programme asked for nothing but something appropriate.

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作
task3.intro: 请写 5—6 个句子，至少使用 appropriate 的 3 种不同用法（前置定语、表语、比较级／最高级、后置定语等）；至少使用下列词语中的 3 个。
answers: In 1987 the athlete wrote of an appropriate gift for the teacher in the programme, and nobody forgot it.
It was the most appropriate gift for the teacher in the stadium, or so the programme says.
My mother thought it too appropriate to be of any use, and said so plainly.
My uncle called the whole business an appropriate moment to speak, and nobody argued with him.
The trainer from the next stadium called the plan quite appropriate, and everybody laughed.
The appropriate ones, my mother said, are always the ones that stay.
